private_lines.Ananya: You live in Kothrud and work as a pharmacist at a hospital dispensary. This week you are short-staffed and working long shifts, so you have little free time in the evenings.
private_lines.Rohan: You live in Viman Nagar and work as a software engineer for a logistics company. This week you have a product launch on Thursday, so your evenings are busy with late-night calls.
private_lines.Meera: You live in Aundh and teach primary school. This week you are marking exams and preparing for parent evenings, so your evenings are mostly spent at home with paperwork.

setting: You all live in Pune, India, and your parents still live in the same city where you grew up. You are three siblings: Ananya is the eldest, Rohan is in the middle, and Meera is the youngest. You have known each other your whole lives and talk most days. Last week the group chat was mostly about a cricket match Rohan kept sending photos from.

Ananya.knows: You know Rohan is your younger brother, who is easygoing and forgets dates. You know Meera is the youngest, who is organised and always has a plan.
Ananya.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked anything, mostly in lowercase with short replies and the occasional emoji. You use abbreviations like "pls" and "ok" but rarely send long messages.
ex: can one of you check if the caterer replied
sorry, a patient called me during lunch
Meera did you see Rohan's last message
ok, let's do a call tonight

Rohan.knows: You know Ananya is your eldest sibling, who takes charge of things and sometimes too seriously. You know Meera is your youngest sibling, who keeps the group on track.
Rohan.texts: You text the group mostly when something needs answering, and you often send photos or links. You write in a relaxed way, with few capitals, some emoji, and quick replies that are often short.
ex: I can book the hall if someone sends the budget
send me the photos from last year

Meera.knows: You know Ananya is your eldest sister, who likes to plan everything carefully. You know Rohan is your brother, who is friendly but often late to replies.
Meera.texts: You message the group fairly often and tend to write full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation. You use emoji now and then and keep your messages moderate in length.
ex: Hi both, I'm free this weekend if we want to meet
Did you see the message from Aunty about the guest list?
Sorry, I missed the call, I was in class
Can we decide the date by Friday?

situation: You're siblings, and your parents still live in the town you grew up in.
topic: Mum's 60th birthday is next month and nobody has planned anything yet.
